title: Aye mere masoom asghar
body:
Ey Mere Masoom Asghar
Ghar Chalo Asghar
Ey Mere Masoom Asghar Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Chand Nikla Aasma Par Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
1) Loot Gai Maa Karbala May Haye Beta Kya Karen
Jub Mera Asghar Nahi Phir Khali Jhula Kya Karen
Ab Na Lag Jae Nazar
Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Ey Mere Masoom Asghar Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Chand Nikla Aasma Par Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
2) Teer Khakar Muskurane Wale Maa Tere Nisar
Gulshan e Karbal Ne Leli Meri Godi Ki bahar
Kya Karen Ab teri Madar
Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Ey Mere Masoom Asghar Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Chand Nikla Aasma Par Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
3)  Kabr May Nanhe Mujahid Nind Kaise Aayegi
Jubbhi Yaad Aayegi Asghar Maa Teri Mar Jaegi
Zulm Hoga Humsafar
Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Ey Mere Masoom Asghar Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Chand Nikla Aasma Par Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
4) Karbala Ja Ab Toe Tera Dil Toe Thanda Hogaya
Teri Mitti May Ali Ka Lal Aakar Sogaya
Ey Mere Lakhte Jigar
Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Ey Mere Masoom Asghar Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Chand Nikla Aasma Par Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
5) Pani Piye Ko Gaye They Khoon Mae Tar Hogaye
Maa Idhar Roti Rahi Or tum Lehed May Sogaye
Kya Mila Dil Todkar
Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Ey Mere Masoom Asghar Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Chand Nikla Aasma Par Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
6) Kya Qayamat Aagai Ehle Haram Tadpa Kiye
Dudh Pine Wale Bacche Khoon May Khela Kiye
Phat Raha Hai Ab jigar
Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Ey Mere Masoom Asghar Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Chand Nikla Aasma Par Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
7) Dekh Ey Shamshir jinki Godiya barbad hai
Unke Sadqe May Toe Ye Her Goud May Aulad Hai
Hai Bada Ehsan Humpar
Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Ey Mere Masoom Asghar Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
Chand Nikla Aasma Par Raat Aai Ghar Chalo
